Shipping & Delivery

Terms & ConditionsPrivacy PolicyCookie PolicyShipping & DeliveryRefunds & SubscriptionsAccessibilityVersion 2026-10-16

Service area

This design assumes hand delivery within a verified New York City service area. The checkout or a member of the studio must confirm eligibility and any fee before the order is accepted. Orders outside the standard area require a written quote and should not be promised automatically.

Timing and lead time

Each product page should show its preparation time and the earliest available delivery date. Subscription delivery schedules and event installations will be confirmed separately. Requested windows are not guaranteed unless Eternaluxe expressly accepts them in writing.

Receiving an arrangement

Provide a complete address, recipient name, working telephone number, access instructions, doorman or loading requirements, and any time restrictions. Certain arrangements may require an adult recipient or an approved protected location. Eternaluxe should never leave an item where weather, heat, cold, pets, or public access creates a foreseeable risk.

Building access and installation

Customers are responsible for permits, venue approvals, freight-elevator reservations, insurance requirements, and accurate site information unless a proposal assigns that work to Eternaluxe. Additional labor, waiting time, parking, tolls, removal, or return visits must be approved under the applicable quote or order terms.

Failed or delayed delivery

If inaccurate details, unavailable access, or an absent recipient prevents delivery, Eternaluxe will contact the customer and explain available redelivery or collection options and any disclosed fee. Weather, transport disruption, venue restrictions, or other events outside reasonable control may require a revised time. Customers should be notified promptly.

Inspection and problems

Inspect the arrangement on arrival. Photograph and report visible damage, a material product error, or a missing order promptly using the contact method below. The published policy should state a realistic reporting window tied to the product’s material type and consumer-law obligations.

Contact

Delivery questions: info@eternaluxenet.com. For order remedies, see Refunds & Subscriptions.
